message: The other night, we had a surprise blackout, and I was so grateful I had charged up our power bank earlier that day. I plugged in my phone and pulled out my trusty flashlight — I even found some old lanterns in the garage! We ended up having a cozy little evening, playing cards by flashlight and laughing about how unprepared I was before. It’s funny how a little prep can turn a potential hassle into a fun memory. What’s your go-to solution for unexpected power outages?
